hits.title: What Is a Quality Assurance Analyst? 2026 Career Guide | Coursera
hits.snippet:
In technical QA analyst jobs such as software quality assurance, you’ll develop and implement testing plans, create test cases and test scripts, and document your findings. You’ll also report defects and track resolutions. This may involve focus groups with customers and monitoring ongoing customer feedback to identify product issues. The main goal of quality assurance is to ensure products meet functional requirements before they make it to the user.

## QA analyst job description [...] Quality assurance analysts are responsible for testing, analyzing, and ensuring the quality of software, products, and systems. They confirm that products or services meet the standards set by the company or the industry in which they’re working. QA has become synonymous with the software development process and technology products. However, jobs in quality assurance are available in various sectors in and outside of the tech industry, including manufacturing, food and beverage, and health [...] Daily responsibilities can vary depending on the industry or company you work for. Here are a few tasks you can expect to manage in most QA roles:

 Planning and implementing product testing

 Establishing procedures and scenarios for quality control

 Reviewing products for defects and errors

 Regression testing

 Conducting software compatibility tests and software design reviews

 Analyzing test results

 Assisting with product designs

 Tracking progress on product issue resolutions
